Author: CheesyChiz
Name: Stock Manager
Punchline: Balances Island Sanctuary stock with imported Visland routes.
Description: Choose Island resources and stock levels, then let Stock Manager select imported Visland routes. Supports sortable resources, farming priorities, flight and underwater navigation, an Island route map, mount override, stuck recovery, Lifestream, surplus export, run statistics, and /sm commands.
Changelog: Added route-wide progress scoring with travel costs, mid-loop target switching, and active-route stuck recovery. Export trips now use Isle Return, stop at the NPC, and exit the cabin before mounting. Added map zoom, pan, all-node/resource filters, and tooltips. Unsafe generated ground tests are disabled pending validation.
